text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy is training hard every<n>day for the
Unicorn Stakes, but is<n>growing tired of doing the
same old<n>routine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's when she gets some good<n>news—she's
been invited to compete<n>in an exhibition race that
will be<n>broadcast live across the country.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A chance to realize her ambition of<n>being the
strongest Umamusume for<n>the next century has
already arrived!<n>Shinko Windy happily accepts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She dives head-first back into training<n>and improves
her running times day<n>after day. When she has a
goal to<n>focus on, there's no stopping her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm left with no doubt that she'll win<n>this race,
making it her first huge step<n>down the road to
achieving her<n>ultimate ambition. But little do I know...
